Name: The Kesselgrund Cup
Notes: WON WHEN is the ordinary condition language. The Cup is handed out by the last row of Season.csv - see its On Win column - so nothing here had to know how a season ends.

Name: The Crown
Notes: A competition on the season shelf. Granted by the the_crown achievement at eight wins.

Name: The Treble
Notes: A trophy does NOT have to come from a competition. This one is three wins, which makes it the row to copy for anything you want on the shelf early.

Name: The Clean Sheet Shield
Notes: Five clean sheets. Shares its condition with the second_vat achievement on purpose - one act can be worth two things.

Name: The Championship
Notes: The season itself. flag:season_won is set when a season is finished as a winner.
